# 金光明經文句

**ID:** T1785
**Volume:** T39
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經疏部
**Byline:** 隋 智顗說  灌頂錄
**Dynasty:** 隋
**Date:** 538–597
**Juans:** 6
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1785

## Contributors
- 智顗 (A001301)
- 灌頂 (A004896)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T1785 in six fascicles is the Tiāntái-school *wénjù* 文句 ("phrase-and-sentence") commentary on *[Jīnguāngmíng jīng 金光明經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301)* (T663). The *wénjù* genre, paired with the *xuányì* 玄義, follows the parent sūtra phrase-by-phrase under the four-section *yīnyuán*, *yuējiào*, *běnjì*, *guānxīn* (因緣, 約教, 本迹, 觀心) interpretive grid characteristic of Zhìyǐ's exegetical method. Together with the *[xuányì (T1783)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304)*, this is the second leg of the Tiāntái commentarial doublet on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa*.

**Abstract**

The opening lines preserved in the Taishō text give the standard Tiāntái attribution: 隋天台智者大師說 / 門人灌頂錄. The dating bracket follows Zhìyǐ's lecturing period at Yùquánsì 玉泉寺 (585–597). The first folio of the work itself frames its reading of [T663](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301)'s 18 chapters as a critique of two prior exegetical traditions — the "Jiāngběi school" (江北諸師) and the "Jiāngnán school" (江南諸師) — both of which had divided the sūtra into a different *xùzhèngliútōng* 序正流通 (introduction / main-doctrine / circulation) tripartite frame. Zhìyǐ's reading rejects both and proposes a new three-part division anchored on the doctrinal centrality of the *Shòuliàng pǐn* 壽量品 (chapter 2 on Buddha's lifespan).

T1785 is foundational for the East Asian *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* commentarial tradition. [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s *[Wénjù jì 文句記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307)* (T1786) is the principal subcommentary; [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s *[Wénjù xīnjì 文句新記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0315)* is the rival but later assimilated Sòng commentary; and the Ming-period [明得](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E5%BE%97) *[Wénjù wénjùjì huìběn 文句文句記會本](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0313)* (X358) collates 智顗 + 灌頂 + 知禮 + 明得 into a single working text. Like T1783, T1785 also figured in the *guānxīn shì* dispute between *shānjiā* and *shānwài*.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0301) (金光明經 / T663); subcommentary [KR6i0307](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307) (金光明經文句記 / T1786).
